summary: React Router v7 migration regression test completed. All 7 frontend scenarios and 3 backend endpoints tested successfully. Fixed critical timezone scope bug in LogsPage.jsx that was breaking the Logs page.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/stats returns 200 with total_contacts, total_visits, today_visits
Frontend 1: All TopNav tabs (Leads, Stealth, Sales, Visitors, Automations, Analytics, Logs) load without errors
Frontend 1: Leads page shows contacts table
Frontend 2: ContactDetailModal opens from Leads page with URL params (?contact=...&tab=overview)
Frontend 2: Modal displays contact data from shared Outlet context
Frontend 3: Unsaved-changes AlertDialog appears when clicking TopNav with unsaved changes
Frontend 3: 'Stay' button keeps user on current page
Frontend 3: 'Leave Without Saving' button navigates away
Frontend 4: Back button triggers unsaved-changes dialog
Frontend 4: Dialog allows leaving via 'Leave Without Saving'
Frontend 5: Save flow redirects to /automations WITHOUT triggering dialog
Frontend 5: Edit flow with unsaved changes triggers dialog when clicking 'Back to Automations'
Frontend 6: Navigation with NO changes proceeds immediately without dialog
Frontend 7: Existing automation loads with name, trigger audience Select, and steps
Frontend 7: Step control buttons (move up/down, duplicate, remove) are present and functional

bugs_fixed_by_testing_agent.issue: ReferenceError: timezone is not defined - timeAgo() function was defined outside component scope but tried to access timezone variable from useTimezone() hook
bugs_fixed_by_testing_agent.fix: Modified timeAgo() to accept timezone as a parameter, updated LogRow component to pass timezone prop, updated all timeAgo() calls to pass timezone
bugs_fixed_by_testing_agent.impact: Logs page was completely broken with white screen error
